name: AEPX patch request schema

request.output_aepx: path to new .aepx; required for apply

operations.kind: rename_comp | rename_layer | set_comment | set_marker | replace_text_source | relink_asset_path

target.kind: project | comp | layer | marker | text_source | asset

selector.xml_id: preferred stable XML id when known
selector.name: fallback exact display name

operations.expected_old_value: required guard for every mutating operation; string for rename_comp, rename_layer, set_comment, replace_text_source, and relink_asset_path; object for set_marker; mismatch fails the operation once apply is implemented
operations.new_value: string or structured marker/path object; string required for rename_comp, rename_layer, set_comment, replace_text_source, and relink_asset_path; object required for set_marker
operations.user_supplied: boolean, must be true for comments, markers, relink paths, and text replacement

options.overwrite: boolean, must be false in v0
options.allow_ambiguous_selector: boolean, must be false in v0

aepx_patch_report_binding.checksum_hex: metadata-only 16-hex checksum over report status/path/metadata/gate/count fields; excludes XML body, selectors, expected/new values, private patch payloads, and elapsed_ms

cryptographic_digest.digest_hex: metadata-only 64-hex digest over the same canonical report fields

metadata.input_exists: boolean; true when input_aepx has filesystem metadata
metadata.input_is_file: boolean; true when input_aepx metadata is a regular file
metadata.observed_file_bytes: integer byte length for regular files, otherwise null
metadata.normalized_input_aepx: normalized input path used for equality/reporting, or null when request JSON did not parse
metadata.normalized_output_aepx: normalized output path used for equality/reporting, or null when absent
metadata.xml_body_read: boolean; false for metadata-only inspect/report normalization

io_gate.xml_body_read_performed: boolean, false in current v0 reports
io_gate.xml_body_write_performed: boolean, false in current v0 reports
io_gate.xml_body_embedded_in_report: boolean, false in current v0 reports
io_gate.private_patch_payloads_embedded_in_repor: boolean, false in current v0 reports
io_gate.external_process_invoked: boolean, false in current v0 reports
io_gate.after_effects_invoked: boolean, false in current v0 reports

write_gate.output_write_performed: boolean, false in current v0 reports
write_gate.source_overwrite_performed: boolean, always false in current v0 reports

notes: Default caller behavior should be dry_run.
Top-level operation is the tool mode; operations[].kind is the edit operation.
apply requires output_aepx and output_aepx must be a new path.
inspect_metadata returns source_not_found when input_aepx is missing or not a file; it must not read the XML body.
input_aepx and output_aepx must not be equal after path normalization.
When output_aepx is supplied for dry_run, noop_validate, or inspect_metadata, v0 still validates that it is an absolute new .aepx path and refuses existing outputs.
Current v0 reports expose io_gate with no XML body read/write, no XML/private payload report embedding, no external process, and no After Effects invocation.
Current v0 reports expose write_gate as not_applied, XML writer not implemented, user approval required before write, output write not performed, and source overwrite not performed.
Current v0 reports expose aepx_patch_report_binding with FNV and sha256-v1 metadata-only values; review packets may require this binding for optional AEPX dry-run evidence.
All mutating operations must include expected_old_value before dry_run or future apply can pass.
publication_status unknown should fail closed before writing.
Synthetic fixtures only; local real .aepx files are manual-smoke material.
Reports must not embed full XML payloads or private project content.
